channel.title: Risk alerts: Korean small and mid-cap filings
channel.description: New risk alerts filings from Korean small and mid caps.

item.title: Monami's common stock has closed below KRW 1,000 for 25 consecutive trading days, raising risk of administrative issue designation.
Korea Exchange warns Yungjin Pharm common shares may be designated administrative issue after 25 trading days below KRW 1,000 close.
Hyundai Bioland common shares halted on 2025-11-25 at 10:57 due to a significant suspension of business; halt lasts 30 minutes.
Actro common stock trading halted on 25 November 2026 due to a bonus share issue, for 30 minutes from halt time.
Sungchang Autotech's market cap has stayed below KRW 20bn for 25 consecutive trading days, risking administrative issue designation.
SCD's common stock has closed below KRW 1,000 for 25 consecutive trading days as of 25 November 2026, raising administrative issue designation risk.
Kga's market capitalization has stayed below KRW 20bn for 25 consecutive trading days, risking administrative issue designation.
4by4 disclosed that its subsidiary Medpictures filed for bankruptcy at the Seoul Bankruptcy Court on 2026-11-25 amid business weakness.
Moda-InnoChips common stock trading suspended from 2026-11-27 as the company will be absorbed by Rosen Co., Ltd. in a merger.
Seoul Southern District Court dismissed Gold&S's injunction request against Korea Exchange to suspend the effect of its delisting decision.
Gold&S changes the end condition of its trading suspension, now lasting until court decision on market-cap delisting or changed circumstances.
KRX designates DHX Company for substantive listing eligibility review under KOSDAQ Listing Rules Article 56(1), citing possible delisting.
Innosimulation's market capitalization has stayed below KRW 20bn for 25 consecutive trading days, raising risk of administrative issue designation.
Abko's common stock closed below KRW 1,000 for 25 consecutive trading days as of November 24, 2026, raising risk of administrative issue designation.
DHX Company's trading suspension period is changed after the company was designated for a listing eligibility substantive review.
Sambu Construction applied to the Seoul Bankruptcy Court on 2026-11-23 to close its rehabilitation proceedings, citing completed major plan obligations.
Medicox says Supreme Court finalized convictions of two former inside directors over KRW 11.3bn embezzlement and breach-of-trust case.
Pims common stock trading resumes on 2026-11-24 after listing of shares changed by par value consolidation
Duoback disclosed its improvement plan after KOSDAQ's review committee granted a nine-month improvement period ending 20 August 2027.
Hyungji I&C filed for an injunction in Seoul Southern District Court to suspend Korea Exchange's delisting and administrative issue designation decisions.
Lotte Non-Life Insurance's board decided a 90% bonus capital reduction, cutting par value per share from KRW 1,000 to KRW 100.
Lotte Non-Life Insurance shares suspended from trading on 19 November 2026 at 16:49 over a capital reduction of 10% or more; trading resumes 20 November.
Kie warned its common shares may be designated an administrative issue as market capitalization stayed below KRW 30bn for 25 trading days.
GeneOne Life Science filed an objection on 19 November 2026 to the delisting decision from its listing eligibility review.
Abion was granted a six-month improvement period by the KOSDAQ Market Committee on November 18, 2026, ending May 18, 2027.
TimeX AI common stock trading suspension to be lifted on November 20, 2026, upon listing of shares changed by reverse split.
Korea Exchange warns Tongyang 2nd preferred shares (new type) face delisting risk for market capitalization below KRW 2bn.
Carry discloses criminal complaint against its CEO and executives alleging KRW 4.28bn embezzlement and breach of trust via short-term loans.
Carry discloses a criminal complaint by an inside director alleging breach of trust by its CEO over a KRW 5.4bn loan.
Orient Precision Industries common stock trading suspended from November 23, 2026 due to a share consolidation (reverse stock split).
Samjin LND Company's share price has closed below KRW 1,000 for 25 consecutive trading days as of November 18, 2026.
SK Securities No.12 SPAC warned of delisting if it misses the 25 November 2026 deadline for its merger listing preliminary review application

item.title: MediaZen's market capitalization has stayed below KRW 20bn for 25 consecutive trading days as of Nov 18, 2026, risking administrative issue designation.
Imagis' market capitalization has been below KRW 20bn for 25 consecutive trading days as of Nov 18, 2026, risking administrative issue designation.
Yuanta 16 Special Purpose Acquisition Company warned of delisting if no merger listing review application is filed by November 25, 2026.
Abion's trading suspension extended after KOSDAQ granted an improvement period, ending May 18, 2027, with a delisting decision to follow.
Dragonfly GF's trading suspension period changed after delisting grounds arose, now lasting until the objection period expires or the delisting decision is made.
Hana 33 Special Purpose Acquisition Company common shares suspended from trading on 2026-11-19 after a delisting reason arose.
VitzroSys board decides a 3-to-1 free capital reduction of common shares, cutting issued shares from 12,590,616 to 4,196,872.
KRX to decide within 15 business days whether KEM Tech is subject to a substantive listing eligibility review, by December 7, 2026.
